datasheet_id_and_revision: SBOSA14A, April 2023, revised November 2023; package option addendum p24 dated 9-Nov (year cut off in text extraction, page not re-read); package materials 24-Jul-2025
scope_of_this_file: headline specifications only (per coordinator); TIA design section 8.1.2 (p17) exists but was not extracted
citation_convention: pN = 1-based PDF page index = printed page number for p1-p23. EC = Sec. 6.5 Electrical Characteristics (p5-p6), defaults: TA ~ 25 C, VS = +-5 V, G = 1 V/V (RF = 0), RF = 250 ohm for G >= 2, RL = 100 ohm, referenced to mid-supply.
value_types: TYP, MIN/MAX (25 C unless over temperature -40 to 85 C), CURVE (PDF vector paths, axis calibration checked against grid lines), DERIVED (computed here)
compensation: unity-gain stable (p1; comparison table p3: minimum stable gain 1 V/V)

supply.recommended: 6 / 10 nom / 12.6 V (p4 Sec. 6.3); comparison table +-6.3 V; abs max dVS/dt 1 V/us

rise_fall_settling.conditions: 200 mV step, G = 1 (1.3 ns at G = 2)

open_loop_dc_gain.conditions: VO = +-0.5 V (70 dB min -40 to 85 C)

open_loop_curve.figure: Fig. 6-23 (p10) 'Open-Loop Gain Magnitude and Phase vs Frequency', annotated RL = 1 GOhm; no simulation label
open_loop_curve.phase_convention: phase of A_OL: -23 deg at 1 kHz, -90 deg plateau, -165 deg at 0.95 GHz
open_loop_curve.crossings: 0 dB at 303 MHz, phase ~ -114 deg -> unity-gain phase margin ~66 deg (DERIVED); phase -135 deg at 561 MHz

current_noise.curve_figure: Fig. 6-21 'Current Noise Density vs Frequency' (p10), 10 kHz-100 MHz; no simulation label
current_noise.hf_behavior: rising proportional to f (slope ~1.0) from ~30 kHz to ~30 MHz, slope ~0.6 between 50 and 100 MHz; not specified above 100 MHz
current_noise.derived_check: DERIVED: i_n / (en x 2 pi f) with en = 5.4 nV/rtHz (plotted white level) = 1.50 pF at 1 MHz, 1.55 pF at 10 MHz, consistent with en acting on a fixed ~1.5 pF.

input_capacitance.definition_notes: EC p6: 'Input impedance common-mode 12 || 2.5 GOhm || pF'; 'Input impedance differential mode 1000 || 0.2 GOhm || pF' (TYP)

input_offset_voltage.type: TYP/MAX, footnote: based on characterization of 32 devices, not ATE-tested

input_common_mode_range.conditions: CMRR > 77 dB (2.0 V min over temp); 3.1 typ / 2.6 min for CMRR > 53 dB
CMRR > 77 dB (-3.7 V over temp); -4.4 typ / -4.0 max for CMRR > 53 dB

output_swing_vs_load_curve.figure: Fig. 6-26 Output Voltage vs Output Current Over Temperature (p11), +-5 V; blue -40 C, black 25 C, red 85 C
output_swing_vs_load_curve.note: at 85 C the swing collapses above ~70 mA (high side ends near 79 mA)

output_current.conditions: VOUT = +-1 V, dVOS < 2 mV (45 mA min over temp, dVOS < 3 mV)

packages.name: D (SOIC-8, drawing D0008A)
packages.body_mm: 4.9 x 6 nominal incl. leads (p1); body 4.81-5.00 x 3.81-3.98 mm, 1.75 mm max height
packages.pinout: 1 NC, 2 IN-, 3 IN+, 4 VS-, 5 NC, 6 OUT, 7 VS+, 8 NC

packages.name: DBV (SOT-23-5, drawing DBV0005A)
packages.body_mm: 2.9 x 2.8 nominal incl. leads; body 2.75-3.05 x 1.45-1.75 mm, 1.45 mm max height
packages.notes: VOS 100 uV typ / 350 uV max and PSRR 77 dB min (vs 79 dB SOIC)

pinout_notes: No FB pin and no power-down pin in either package (p3).
abs_max_and_input_protection: p4: VS 13 V; dVS/dt 1 V/us; VI VS- to VS+; VID VS- to VS+; II +-10 mA (ESD diodes to supplies); IO +-30 mA; TJ 150 C; Tstg -65 to 150 C; ESD HBM +-2000 V, CDM +-1500 V.
other_notes: Comparison table (p3): OPA814 +-6.3 V, 250 MHz, FET, 750 V/us, 5.3 nV/rtHz, G >= 1.
Closed-loop output impedance 0.01 ohm at 100 kHz, G = 1 (p6 EC).
inconsistencies_and_uncertainties: Input current noise: EC gives 11 fA/rtHz for f > 100 kHz, but the Fig. 6-21 curve is 5 fA/rtHz at 100 kHz and rises proportional to f (0.05 pA/rtHz at 1 MHz, 0.53 at 10 MHz, 3.9 near 100 MHz).
p1 description says 'available in an 8-pin SOIC package' while the package table and addendum also list the 5-pin SOT-23 (DBV).
A_OL plot annotated RL = 1 GOhm, unlike the EC default 100 ohm.
pages_read: First pass: p1-p24 rendered at 160 dpi and p25-p33 read at 160 dpi. Second pass: p1, p3, p4, p5, p6 at 120 dpi and p10, p11 at 110 dpi read; curves digitized from vector paths of p10-p11. Not re-read: p2 (contents), p7-p9 and p12-p23 (typical curves, application/TIA/layout text, revision history), p24 (package option addendum; orderables taken from p25 tape-and-reel table).
